purpose: A post-search, witness-hidden calibration of the degree-four covering solver. This benchmark does not select a new class or constitute a point-search chart wave.

classes.recovered_control: The eight elements of H = M24 intersect ker(loc_S), where dim_F2(H)=3.
classes.missing_strict_coset: R + H, where R is the fixed displayed strict word P4+P12+P18+P23+P27, known post hoc to lie outside M24.

solver.engine: Magma GenusOneModel Minimise/Reduce followed by PointsQI

blinding: The solver subprocess receives a sealed JSON file containing only a token and two integral quadric equations.
It receives neither alpha, a public word, a point coordinate, a coset label, nor an expected witness.
Only after the solver terminates does the parent process map a returned cover point to E302 and test its Kummer character against M24.
advance_gate: PASS requires at least one nonzero recovered-control representative and at least one missing-coset representative to yield an exact rational cover point. Bounded misses, timeouts, or a trivial-cover hit alone do not pass the gate.
boundaries: Each cover is known retrospectively to be soluble, but no witness is passed to the solver.
A completed bounded solver run that finds no point is not an obstruction or a Sha certificate.
A successful missing-coset calibration is not counted as a newly recovered direction: its strict word is a forbidden prospective input for the next construction phase.
